title: IaaS Network Provider Values
description: Schema for the iaas-network-provider wrapper chart values.

iaas-network-provider.title: IaaS Network Provider
iaas-network-provider.description: Values passed to the vendored iaas-network-provider subchart.

image.title: Image
image.description: Container image settings for the iaas-network-provider controller.

tag.title: Image tag
tag.description: Container image tag. If empty in the child chart, the chart defaults to v + appVersion.

bindAddress.title: Bind address
bindAddress.description: Controller HTTPS listen address. TLS is always on; this also determines the container port and probe port.

hostAliases.title: Host aliases
hostAliases.description: Entries injected into the pod /etc/hosts file to bypass DNS resolution. Useful for mapping IaaS provider endpoints to specific IPs without relying on CoreDNS.

items.description: Host alias entry added to the pod /etc/hosts file.

ip.description: IP address to add to /etc/hosts, for example 10.20.1.100.

hostnames.description: Hostnames mapped to the IP address, for example iam-apigateway-proxy.nbcbcloud.com.

items.description: Hostname mapped to the host alias IP address.

cloud.title: IaaS provider
cloud.description: Cloud provider API configuration. The default provider is Huawei Cloud.

accessConfig.title: Access config
accessConfig.description: Cloud provider region, project and service endpoints.

endpoint.title: Provider endpoint
endpoint.description: Base endpoint for the IaaS provider API.

vpcEndpoint.title: VPC endpoint
vpcEndpoint.description: Optional VPC service endpoint. Leave empty to use the provider default endpoint.

ecsEndpoint.title: ECS endpoint
ecsEndpoint.description: Optional ECS service endpoint. Leave empty to use the provider default endpoint.

iamEndpoint.title: IAM endpoint
iamEndpoint.description: IAM endpoint, for example https://iam-apigateway-proxy.nbcbcloud.com. Required when auth.mode=token.

scEndpoint.title: SC endpoint
scEndpoint.description: SC service endpoint used to query delegated tenant information, for example https://sc.nbcbcloud.com.

securityGroups.title: Security groups
securityGroups.description: Security group IDs used by the provider, for example securityGroupID1.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Authentication settings for the IaaS provider API. Credentials are read from an existing Secret: ak-sk mode uses CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY / CLOUD_SECRET_KEY, token mode uses CLOUD_PASSWORD.

mode.title: Authentication mode
mode.description: Authentication mode. Supported values are ak-sk and token.

secret.title: Credentials secret
secret.description: Existing Secret containing the cloud credentials.

agencyName.title: Agency name
agencyName.description: Agency name. If trustTenantName is set, the controller can query SC and override this value from the matched trust tenant.

trustTenantName.title: Trust tenant name
trustTenantName.description: Delegated tenant name used to match agency_name from trust_vdc_list, for example nbyh.
